prerequisites: To enroll in the Final Degree Project, the student must be enrolled in all remaining subjects required to complete their studies and comply with the prerequisites established for the TFG in the study plan.
The TFG may be submitted and defended once the student has a maximum of 15 credits left to pass from the remaining subjects of the study plan.

learning_outcomes.text: That students can transmit information, ideas, problems and solutions to both specialized and non-specialized audiences.

Original exercise to be carried out individually and presented and defended before a university tribunal, consisting of a project in the field of specific Mechanical Engineering technologies of a professional nature in which the competencies acquired in the studies are synthesized and integrated.

assessment_methods.method: Defense of the Final Degree Project before a tribunal

assessment_rules: Evaluation will be carried out according to the regulations on Final Degree and Master Projects at EPSJ. The grading criteria and their weighting are: aspects specific to the TFG (60%), formal aspects (25%), and aspects related to the defense of the work (15%). In each criterion section, the different items will have the same weight. The grading system will be governed by RD 1125/2003 of September 5.
